Character text re-set from your Dextrous scans, the Inspect text fix, framed character cards in the PreCon Arena hand, colour-coded Bookmarks and framed Critical Lenses. Nothing here is wired into the game yet.

Slide to lay your scan over the live card. Text here is copied from the scans so the overlay lines up; in game the text comes from card data.

Same frame and plate as the Act cards, with the Active / Bench buttons and the ⓘ details button kept.

Laid out like the print: name band, vertical BOOKMARK spine, art, kind and text, rarity mark. Legendary cards are black whatever their kind. Support is not on your list, so it keeps the dark brown from your scan.
